description: Unofficial Yuzuki Yukari fan-art companion in a simplified lavender dress, stockings and black red-lined coat. Original choreography includes settling coat corners, turning a crescent bookmark, seated booklet recovery and quiet waiting, arranging paper notes, articulated directional strides and a tiny hop. Familiar hair and costume cues are adapted from the front reference; unseen hood-ear details are not asserted.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
